scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run uvicorn playlist_optimizer.main:app --reload
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:sidecar && tauri build --bundles app
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @playlist-optimizer/web && cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run ruff check .
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @playlist-optimizer/web && cd apps/api && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run pytest
